scope: Exact installed PE32 CLI parent and same-run.js spawned children, existing enumerated Node Workers; static read inventory, not exhaustive guest-dependent DLL demand.

mandatory.fonts: BUNDLED_BITMAP_FONTS + substitutions.json + fontMounts({subset:true}); 27 unique data files including system data; no full fonts
mandatory.module: explicit canonical --no-build --wasm; compile-guard checks accepted bytes and rejects source compiler
mandatory.registry: exact mutable/registry.json; child imports/exports produced inside quota
mandatory.vfs: entire original mutable/vfs, DLL seed native mss32.dll; VFS callbacks and runtime DLL search read retained original files

plannedConditionalReads.lib/host-import-sigs.generated.json: Worker/render-worker signatures; preexisting pinned runtime data, not newly added
plannedConditionalReads.DLL/COM/help reads: Guest-demand callback paths; original VFS and module stubs; absent guest-requested inputs fail first boundary, never downloaded or fabricated
plannedConditionalReads.child VFS/registry: Only real CreateProcess route; input/parent/child export overlap controlled by unchanged observer
plannedConditionalReads./proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id: Named-event clock-domain conditional OS data, not transferable runtime asset
plannedConditionalReads.PNG buffers: Pinned 23-file pngjs dependency; decoding takes Buffer in this command
plannedConditionalReads.vfs-export.js: Child merge reads bounded host export plus optional existing files; source clone retained

excludedReads.source WAT / wat-manifest / compile-wat: --no-build explicit canonical input and rejecting preload; no source fallback
excludedReads.test/run.js app local manifest: Direct --exe points inside retained mutable clone, no --app or matching repository app exe path
excludedReads.test/run.js ZIP/ISO/CUE/tracks/import-sa: No media, import-saves, overlay or app mode flags
excludedReads.test/run.js input file event/audio outpu: No file-bearing input event/audio-out flags; any future ordinary click only after genuine window
excludedReads.win16StageModule / WIN16_LIBS / ordinals: Both original target commands PE32; no trace-win16; generated ordinal JSON already pinned
excludedReads.save-bundle.js .git detection: No save bundle export; optional metadata reader catches absence
excludedReads.raster-canvas.js path read: Renderer internal PNG decoding uses Buffer; no external image path option

workerRoots.expression: new Worker(__filename, { workerData: { role: 'authority', endpoint: this.endpoint, buffer } });

enumerationLimit: Explicit roots and static Node requires; actual Worker/child instances logged only if created by the one session.
